name: cascade_delete
description: In `app.delete('/api/customers/:c_custkey')`, child `orders` records are explicitly deleted via `Order.destroy({ where: { o_custkey } })` before the parent `customer` is deleted. The `app.get('/api/orders/summary')` endpoint depends on all historical orders to compute `total_orders` and `total_revenue`, so deleting orders permanently removes data that this read endpoint expects, causing incomplete or missing summary data.
